newsitem.title: KUWAIT: NationsBank gets part of Kuwait Airways deal.
newsitem.headline: NationsBank gets part of Kuwait Airways deal.

text.p: Kuwait Airways Corp said on Wednesday it picked NationBank of the United States for the $114 million first phase financing of two new Boeing Co 777-200 on order.
But "we have told the bidders that this decision is subject to final approval by our (government) auditing authorities," the airline's deputy director general, Yussef al-Jassem, told Reuters.
The tender to finance the two aircraft ordered in July for delivery in 1998 was closed in early November. Kuwait Airways has an option on a third 777 twinjet.
Jassem said another tender would be made in 1997 to finance the remainder of the $280 million Boeing order.
Domestic, regional and international bidders included:

CitiBank and Chase of the United States, Japan's Sumitomo Bank, the Bahrain-based Gulf International Bank, a consortium of Kuwaiti banks under National Bank of Kuwait and Kuwait's The International Investor Co.
The new 777s will replace two Boeing 747s currently in service. The airline also operates 15 Airbus Industrie aircraft.
